gloss_en: white fire (esh levanah) — the Hebrew rendering of the Aramaic 'tzutzita de-nura chivarta' (tuft of white fire) atop the ship-sinking wave in Rabbah bar bar Chanah's tale (Bava Batra 73a), symbolizing the evil inclination's deceptive garb of apparent holiness when it clothes itself in mitzvot, though it remains a destructive angel
